source.engine: CYBR ELEMENTS directional optical slab derivative
source.sourceTerms: Native emission + captured soot in-scattering from unchanged radiance().
source.method: Exact front-to-back Beer-Lambert composition of native adjacent-endpoint midpoint coefficient cells; effective source coefficient and extinction, not averaged RGB.
limitations: Controlled directional optical approximation, not a replacement native simulation.
Exact frontal composition before half quantization against native midpoint integration; not exact arbitrary-angle transport.
Native full XY samples preserved; source-space depth is preintegrated.
Frozen soot in-scattering retained; no new spectral or multiple-scattering solution.

opticalSlabs.depthSampling: piecewise-constant; snap Z to slab center, retain XY linear filtering
opticalSlabs.raySteps: clip entry and exit and each source-space slab face; do not interpolate adjacent effective slabs

capture.reactionSource: Native state channel7 = actual burn/dt, not inferred from temperature.
capture.zeroHaloProof: Original crop bounded every nonzero half voxel; all restored neighboring native cells were exactly zero.
capture.depthBoundary: Each boundary slab stores its complete native optical transfer; its effective coefficient is not an exactly-zero boundary sample.
